title: NUAK1 Promotes Diabetic Kidney Disease by Accelerating Renal Tubular Senescence via the ROS/P53 Axis.
authors: Guo, Lei; Wu, Peili; Li, Qing; Feng, Qijian; Lin, Xiaochun; Luo, Yuling; Wang, Yuan; Wu, Minghai; Cai, Feifei; Zhang, Jin; Hu, Yuxuan; Wang, Huiyun; Wang, Yu; Luo, Sirui; Tian, Linlin; Fan, Xinzhao; Wang, Ling; Xue, Yaoming; Guan, Meiping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NUAK1在糖尿病肾病中通过ROS/P53轴促进肾小管衰老的机制，虽涉及ETS1转录因子与NUAK1启动子结合的ChIP验证及分子对接/动力学模拟，但核心是疾病病理而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法仅作为辅助验证，与本课题关联度有限。
abstract: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) progression involves intricate interactions among senescence, oxidative stress, inflammation, and fibrosis. This study systematically investigates the regulatory role and molecular mechanisms of NUAK1 in DKD pathogenesis. Bioinformatics analysis of Gene Expression Omnibus data sets identified NUAK1 as a differentially expressed gene, validated in human kidney proximal tubule epithelial (HK-2) cells, high-fat diet and streptozotocin-induced DKD mice, d-galactose-induced senescent mice, and human peripheral blood mononuclear cells. Functional studies demonstrated that NUAK1 inhibition via siRNA knockdown, pharmacological inhibitors, or kidney tubule-targeted adeno-associated virus serotype carrying shRNA against NUAK1 delivery attenuated reactive oxygen species-tumor protein 53 (ROS/P53) axis-mediated renal tubular senescence, oxidative stress, inflammation, and fibrosis in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, chromatin immunoprecipitation quantitative PCR revealed that transcription factor ETS1 directly binds to the NUAK1 promoter, driving its transcriptional activation in DKD. Furthermore, molecular docking and dynamics simulations identified Asiatic acid (AA) as a potent NUAK1 inhibitor, with a stable binding affinity. AA suppressed NUAK1 expression and downstream pathological processes, ameliorating renal injury in DKD models. These findings elucidate the role and regulatory mechanisms of NUAK1 in modulating ROS/P53 axis-driven tubular senescence and oxidative stress, providing a theoretical basis for structure optimization in drug development targeting NUAK1. ARTICLE HIGHLIGHTS: Mechanisms linking renal tubular senescence to diabetic kidney disease (DKD) progression remain poorly understood. Systematic elucidation of the regulatory role of NUAK1 in the pathogenesis of DKD and its regulatory mechanisms is provided. NUAK1 is upregulated in DKD, promoting senescence via reactive oxygen species-tumor protein 53 under transcriptional activation by E26 transformation-specific 1, while Asiatic acid (AA) directly binds NUAK1 to suppress these pathological processes. NUAK1 emerges as a therapeutic target for DKD, and AA provides a natural scaffold for NUAK1 inhibitor development, offering a strategy to combat diabetes-related renal decline.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DKD）的进展涉及衰老、氧化应激、炎症和纤维化之间复杂的相互作用。本研究系统探讨了NUAK1在DKD发病机制中的调控作用及分子机制。对基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus）数据集的生物信息学分析将NUAK1鉴定为差异表达基因，并在人肾近端小管上皮（HK-2）细胞、高脂饮食和链脲佐菌素诱导的DKD小鼠、d-半乳糖诱导的衰老小鼠以及人外周血单核细胞中进行了验证。功能研究表明，通过siRNA敲低、药理学抑制剂或携带靶向NUAK1的shRNA的肾小管靶向腺相关病毒血清型递送抑制NUAK1，可在体外和体内减轻活性氧-肿瘤蛋白53（ROS/P53）轴介导的肾小管衰老、氧化应激、炎症和纤维化。机制上，染色质免疫沉淀定量PCR揭示转录因子ETS1直接结合NUAK1启动子，驱动其在DKD中的转录激活。此外，分子对接和动力学模拟鉴定出积雪草酸（AA）为一种有效的NUAK1抑制剂，具有稳定的结合亲和力。AA抑制NUAK1表达及下游病理过程，改善DKD模型中的肾损伤。这些发现阐明了NUAK1在调节ROS/P53轴驱动的肾小管衰老和氧化应激中的作用及调控机制，为靶向NUAK1的药物开发中的结构优化提供了理论基础。文章亮点：肾小管衰老与糖尿病肾病（DKD）进展之间的机制联系仍知之甚少。系统阐明了NUAK1在DKD发病中的调控作用及其调控机制。NUAK1在DKD中上调，在E26转化特异性1的转录激活下通过活性氧-肿瘤蛋白53促进衰老，而积雪草酸（AA）直接结合NUAK1以抑制这些病理过程。NUAK1成为DKD的治疗靶点，AA为NUAK1抑制剂开发提供了天然支架，为对抗糖尿病相关肾功能衰退提供了策略。
